summary: The URL normalizer is called in the link-creation flow before persistence, and the supplied current build and test results pass. The implementation, tests, and documentation cover the requested transformations.
rationale: LinkService.CreateAsync invokes UrlNormalizer.Normalize(request.LongUrl) before calling the creation repository, so newly created links are saved with the normalized destination. The normalizer lowercases the scheme and host, removes HTTP port 80 and HTTPS port 443 while retaining non-default ports, and removes query parameter names beginning with utm_ case-insensitively. Unit and API integration tests cover these transformations; the persistence integration test verifies the saved value. Documentation describes the behavior. The supplied current run reports dotnet build succeeded and dotnet test: 105 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
content:
## Requirement review

| Requirement | Implementation | Test coverage | Documentation | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowercase the URL scheme and host. | `src/UrlShortener.Application/Links/UrlNormalizer.cs`, `UrlNormalizer.Normalize` lowercases both components. Called by `src/UrlShortener.Application/Links/LinkService.cs` in `CreateAsync` before link creation. | `tests/UrlShortener.UnitTests/UrlNormalizerTests.cs`, `NormalizeAppliesOnlyRequestedUrlTransformations`; `tests/UrlShortener.IntegrationTests/UrlNormalizationApiTests.cs`, `CreateLinkReturnsAndRedirectsToNormalizedDestination`. | `docs/features/url-destination-handling.md`, “What it does.” | Covered. |
| Remove default ports. | `UrlNormalizer.Normalize` removes port 80 for HTTP and 443 for HTTPS, while retaining other ports. | Unit tests and API integration cases cover both default ports and a non-default port. | The feature document states the default-port rules and that non-default ports are retained. | Covered. The current tests exercise the previously failing port-removal cases. |
| Strip `utm_` tracking parameters before a link is saved. | `UrlNormalizer.StripUtmParameters` removes matching parameter names case-insensitively. `LinkService.CreateAsync` normalizes before calling `TryCreateAsync`. | Unit tests cover case-insensitive removal, retaining similarly named parameters, query ordering/values, and fragments. `UrlNormalizationPersistenceApiTests.CreateLinkReturnsAndPersistsNormalizedDestination` checks the API result and database value. | The feature document describes the prefix, case-insensitive matching, and retained non-matching parameters. | Covered. |

## Gaps and risks

No requirement gaps found in the supplied current files. The supplied current build and test results report success; no additional build or test results are asserted here.

Verdict: PASS
